subject: Renewal + seat uplift: orderbook & MSA redlines
messages:
From: BrightField Procurement <procurement@brightfield.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@brightfield.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2029 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase proposal

Hi Karthik / Priyom,

Thanks for the continued partnership — BrightField is planning to renew our MSA for another 18 months and we expect to increase usage across the research and analytics teams. High-level asks:

- Extend MSA term to 18 months (from 12) to align with our budget cycle.
- Add 120k token/month capacity (we currently have 40k).
- Confirm SLAs for inference latency for dedicated pool (p50/p95).

I attached the OrderForm (v3) with proposed seat/usage numbers and a spreadsheet with projected ramp. Can you confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for legal redlines? Our procurement deadline is Sep 10.

Attachments: BrightField_OrderForm_v3.pdf, capacity_uplift_schedule.xlsx

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Partner | BrightField Technologies

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: BrightField Procurement <procurement@brightfield.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase proposal

Elena — thanks for the note and the materials. Short reply to align on internal owners and expectations:

- Priyom (CC) will lead the orderform/redline cadence with you.
- Lauren (CC) will route the MSA redlines through Legal Ops and handle the signature path.
- We can target a T+10 day turnaround for an internal redline if there are no material changes to scope.

Two immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether BrightField requires data residency (EU/US) constraints for the new workloads? That will affect the routing and SLA language.
2) We will propose a term amendment (18 months) plus an addendum for the capacity uplift. Legal will prefer a single addendum that references the existing MSA rather than a full MSA replacement.

I attached a working redline for the OrderForm and a short comment log — this is our starting point so Legal has visibility (MSA_Redlines_karthik_v2.docx). Priyom — take it away for the legal sweep.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_Redlines_karthik_v2.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Aug 2029 11:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated redlines: OrderForm + Addendum (questions inline)

Elena — attaching a consolidated redline set. Summary of changes and open items (high level):

- OrderForm: reconciled pricing tiers for the uplift; added prorated billing for partial-month ramp.
- Addendum: new Section 3.2 added to define "Capacity Units" and burst handling; added fallback routing policy clause.
- Term: proposed 18-month term with a 30-day early-termination right for failure to meet the p95 latency SLA in two consecutive months. Legal flagged this for internal review — asking if BrightField can accept a cure period instead of immediate termination.
- Data residency: we marked the field-level residency question as TBD — can you confirm whether BrightField requires US-only or if cross-region caching is acceptable?

Please see inline comments in the attached OrderForm and Addendum. For execution: we can provide a clean DocuSign packet once the redlines are finalized. Proposed timeline: legal back-and-forth this week, final packet ready by Mon Sep 2.

Attachments: BrightField_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf, OrderForm_Addendum_v1.docx

Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated redlines: OrderForm + Addendum (questions inline)

Priyom — appreciate the fast turnaround. A few quick points:

- BrightField can accept the 18-month term.
- On the p95 SLA termination language: procurement prefers a cure period (30 days) and then a credit, rather than outright termination. Can you update the clause to include a 30-day cure and service credit schedule?
- Data residency: primary workloads must remain US residency; cross-region caching for KV prefixes is acceptable if encrypted and logged. Please add an audit logging clause referencing our SOC2 checklist.

If you can return an updated addendum that captures those two items, we can prepare the internal approval and send for signature. We'll expect the DocuSign packet and a HubSpot deal update once the clean doc is ready.
